bounds.domain: Two runs, three unique trace IDs, one record per ID, and a three-tick wall clock with a two-tick TTL. Each active trace records whether it was enriched at least once.
bounds.limitations: Every index change is synchronous. Explicit purge and the periodic purge on recording use the same sweep. The model abstracts the every-100-record counter, score values, wall-clock rollback, missing run IDs and persistence. Progress starts at an already-expired trace and requires the purge to run.

assumptions: No fairness assumption. Newly enriched traces belong to one active run.
Purge is weakly fair while expired traces remain. A direct trace or run removal can retire them sooner.
No fairness assumption. An expired trace can remain resident when nobody requests a purge or removal.
